task_text: Someone with the flu needs a place to rest and recover. I need a room set up within 20 minutes — comfortable to rest in, with easy access to water and any basics they might need.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a glass of water and any light snacks, then pass them to R2 when it arrives in the kitchen.
central_instructions.R2: Go to the kitchen to receive water and snacks from R1, then deliver them to R3 in the bedroom.
central_instructions.R3: Set up the bedroom with the delivered water and snacks, ensuring the room is comfortable for rest.
central_instructions.R4: Ensure the bathroom is stocked with essentials like tissues and hand sanitizer, and be ready to assist if needed.

- R1 [LOCAL] Fill the mug with water from the tap. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]

- R1 [LOCAL] Slice the tomato into small pieces. (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the sliced tomato on a plate. (r1_s5)

[15-20 min]
- R2 [RECEIVE] Arrive in the kitchen to receive items. (r2_s1)
- R1 [PASS] Hand the mug of water and plate of sliced tomato to R2. (r1_s6)
